# Document Review Output

```text
Document review: pass|changes-required|not-required|blocked
Profile: <one best-fit reviewer or none>
Reason: <selection or skip reason>
Source SHA-256: <hash>
Counts: P0=N P1=N P2=N P3=N
Receipt: <path>
```

For each finding include section, evidence quote, why it matters, confidence,
autofix class, and a specific fix or decision owner. Do not print a reviewer
roster because at most one reviewer runs.
